hero.title: Your roadmap is a guess.
hero.sub: An MCP server that hands your agents verified customer outcomes — and the evidence behind them.

problem.title: Opinion is expensive.

beats.quote: Roadmaps set by whoever talks loudest.
beats.support: Decisions default to seniority, not evidence.

beats.quote: Features for customers who never asked.
beats.support: Nobody validated the outcome; only the idea.

beats.quote: Agents fluent in everything, grounded in nothing.
beats.support: A model will confidently invent your customer.

problem.closer: Add it up and the roadmap isn't a plan. It's a guess.

insight.title: Ask for outcomes, not opinions.
paragraphs: Outcome-Driven Innovation asks customers how much each desired outcome matters and how satisfied they are with it today.
The gap between importance and satisfaction is where products win or die.
Agentic ODI stores those outcomes, scores them, and serves them to any agent over MCP.

surfaces.title: The agent composes, it does not describe.
surfaces.blurb: The studio answers with a card from a closed catalog, rendered inline in the conversation. Twelve shapes, each one a thing you can act on.

cards.title: Outcome
cards.blurb: A desired outcome with its importance, its satisfaction, and the gap between them.

cards.title: Opportunity board
cards.blurb: Several scored outcomes, ranked by the opportunity each one leaves open.

outcomes.statement: Catch a failed payment before it churns
Hand a refund back in one step

cards.title: Impact simulation
cards.blurb: What changes if you take the bet, set against what happens if you do not.

data.before: Two hours a week, per finance lead, matching lines by hand.
data.after: Exceptions only. The team reviews what did not match.

cards.title: Evidence
cards.blurb: The customer words behind a score, with where they came from.

data.quote: I spend every Friday matching invoices to receipts. It is the part of the job I dread.

cards.title: Job map
cards.blurb: The steps of the job-to-be-done, in the order the customer does them.

cards.title: Thesis
cards.blurb: One opportunity argued in plain language: the scores, the gap, the thesis, and the next move.

data.title: Reconcile invoices without manual effort
data.gap: Finance leads spend two hours a week matching lines by hand.
data.thesis: The work is not the matching. It is the exceptions nobody has time to chase.
data.next_move: Run a one-week pilot with the three highest-volume vendors.

data.decision: Automate invoice matching before we build a refund flow
data.rationale: Opportunity 13.0 against 7.0, and two evidence quotes in the last quarter.

cards.title: Opportunity brief
cards.blurb: The factual case for one job: the decision, the underserved outcomes with their score, band, and sample size, and the sources.

data.decision: Automate invoice matching before we build a refund flow

outcomes.statement: Minimize the time it takes to reconcile invoices when a statement arrives
Minimize the effort it takes to hand a refund back when a customer asks

cards.title: Decision review
cards.blurb: A past decision re-examined against today's numbers: how long ago it was made, and per chosen outcome what moved. A missing measurement reads no evidence, never no change.

data.title: Is invoice automation still the right bet?

outcomes.statement: Minimize the time it takes to reconcile invoices when a statement arrives

cards.title: Bet
cards.blurb: A recorded expectation: the hypothesis, the outcome it targets, the baseline captured at creation, the target, and the date to look. The baseline is stored, never recomputed.

data.title: Reconcile in under five minutes
data.hypothesis: Auto-matching receipts halves the weekly reconciliation time

cards.title: Comparison
cards.blurb: Two bets on the same axes, one row per metric and one column per bet, so the choice is visible instead of argued.

steps.title: Talk
steps.body: One room. Describe a job, or paste what a customer said. The studio captures jobs, steps, and desired outcomes from plain language — and every score stays editable by hand.

steps.title: Ask
steps.body: Any agent calls the same MCP tools the studio uses: job maps, outcomes, evidence, opportunity scores. Thirty tools, at decision time, from your own machine or the hosted server.

steps.title: Steer
steps.body: The team decides from the same picture. Scored outcomes, opportunity boards, and bet simulations, composed inline by the agent and reviewable by a human.

run.title: Run it in 60 seconds.
run.lede: Clone the workspace, or install the binary. Either way you get the MCP server and the Living Studio.

tabs.label: uv workspace
tabs.code:
git clone https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi.git
cd agentic-odi
uv sync --all-packages
npm --prefix apps/studio run build
python scripts/dev.py
